description.value: Bighorn Campground sits inside Syringa Provincial Park on the shore of Arrow Lake Reservoir, offering swimming, fishing, and boating with full amenities including showers and potable water. Access is straightforward via paved Hwy 3A, 19 km from Castlegar, though the gate closes at season's end and reservations are accepted.
